notes: T2 simulation constants, v2 (2026-09-11). android_glm / android_ds are rebuilt from experimental-results/guiexp_android/t16_build/constants_table.json: 7 AndroidWorld families x 2 models, headline unit PRICE-WEIGHTED TOKENS (pw) = (prompt - cached) + r_c*cached + r_o*completion. The three old android layouts (contacts/calendar/markor) are superseded by the seven named families. openapps_glm / openapps_ds are UNCHANGED and are still in cache-adjusted tokens (fresh + r*cached), a DIFFERENT unit: do not compare absolute tokens across the android and openapps cost sets. m=91 and tau0=368 are carried over from the OpenApps m_library2 measurement; the t16_build table measures neither. Every per-family value is the measured headline of its cell; where a cell has no measured value (no deploy stage, or no compile that passed the gate) the layout's `note` says which model-level median was substituted. See computer-use/t2sim/CONSTANTS_V2.md.

android_qw.note: Third model, measured 2026-09-20; body/table integration pending (rows live under measurement_update_20260918.json `qwen_rows`). floor_raw_tokens is null: no qwen Android no-task floor has been measured (GLM 5090 / DeepSeek 2290 predate this model), so the AndroidWorld rows' c and L_doc are UNSUBTRACTED; the two OSWorld floors are per-cell (18 runs each) and already subtracted. The L_doc median spans the 5 rows with a doc arm. OsmAndMarker was rejected at verification after repair rounds under the image-413-guard completion (no deploy stage); its engine-facing C/d/q0 are the model median over the admitted rows and its own failed-build price is under measured.C_with_repair. CalcTableSave was TERMINATED by operator ruling inside the gate stage (artifact wedge: exception-swallowing retry loops defeat the replay deadline (wedge.md)); verification/deploy/doc_arm never ran, so its C is the PARTIAL translator+builder spend (the gate stage makes no model calls) and is a LOWER BOUND on a failed build. WebArena CommentPost is absent: provider content-filter refusal (400 data_inspection_failed), deterministic, floor 18/18 passed, single Alibaba endpoint.

trigger.note: horizon_cap = 1/h at the old engine's drift hazard h=0.02 (Theorem 2 lifetime, 50 uses); the projection is H=lambda_hat*min-uses capped at it. The threshold also carries the manifest externality m*t (methods-v2 section 2 one-line extension), inert at m=0. v2: gate_prior='pi' and spend_cap=on are Algorithm 1 as decided 2026-09-11; cooldown='inflate' and half_life=120 are left at their published values (methods-v3 section 3 removes the cooldown, which is a separate change and is NOT made here).
